title: JSON-RPC 2.0 Method: upload_clip
description: New method added to router.py's AIRouter. Called by Electron main process to instruct the Python bridge to encode, upload, and report a violation clip.

tempFilePath.description: Absolute path to the temp .webm file written by Electron main process in os.tmpdir(). Python bridge owns cleanup of this file.

studentId.description: Extracted from metadata.studentId for convenience; used in CDN path and backend event.

evidenceUrl.description: CDN URL. Present and non-null only when uploadStatus == 'success'.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason on failure. null on success.

sideEffects: Writes a .mp4 temp file in os.tmpdir() via ffmpeg-python (cleaned up in try/finally).
Deletes the .webm temp file passed in tempFilePath (cleaned up in try/finally).
HTTP PUT to Bunny CDN storage using BUNNY_API_KEY from environment variables.
HTTP POST to the backend LMS API emitting an AiProctoringViolationEvent (see backend-violation-event.json).
securityNotes: BUNNY_API_KEY is read exclusively from environment variables inside clip_upload_service.py.
BUNNY_API_KEY MUST NOT appear in the JSON-RPC params, result, error, or any log output.
tempFilePath is an absolute local path — it MUST NOT be sent back to the renderer in any IPC message.

ClipMetadata.description: Same schema as defined in ipc-save-and-upload-clip.json#/definitions/ClipMetadata. Repeated here for router.py contract completeness.
